verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago has an API reference page (/developers/en/reference) that promotes Postman for creating, testing and sharing requests. This suggests a vendor-supported way to run API calls from the reference, but not an interactive in-page reference with runnable examples. The MCP documentation search and the CLI are adjacent capabilities and are not credited. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable code samples embedded in the reference, explicit confirmation of an official Postman collection, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
